title: Headline stat reveal
summary: One to four headline numbers, each the hero of its own beat: digits roll or count up and stop, a meter fills only when the number is a share of a whole, the label rises in, and a recap sets every number side by side over a source line.
needs: The numbers, what each one counts, and who published them (a source), stated in the brief
gallery_share: Count-up statistics and 'by the numbers' cards are a staple of annual reports, impact reels and launch posts.
limits: The template takes exactly three numbers; the recipe takes one to four.
Meters fill only for percentages in the template (or a stated whole via the recipe's scales); other numbers get a neutral ring.
Verbatim units are checked as text in the brief, so a one-letter unit such as M passes whenever that letter appears; a reviewer still checks units against the source.
Latin digits and Inter (or the system sans) only; very long numbers shrink, and the render fails rather than overflow.
